understanding.goal_understanding: Progress through all levels by placing every selectable piece onto goal tiles marked '+' at the same time; if there are multiple goals in a level, all must be occupied simultaneously to trigger WIN within the per-level step budget.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: The currently selected piece (player.id at player.position) moves one grid cell per MOVE action (cell size 3 pixels; positions are given in pixel coordinates). Movement can be blocked or altered by walls/boundaries, and pushable objects (e.g., blocks) can be pushed if adjacent in the move direction so they slide together with the piece. Levels may include multiple selectables; control switches via CLICK on a selectable's exact pixel position from the state. The movement.*_blocked flags are only hints about adjacency and do not guarantee a move will fail.
